faq_heading: Homes near Alex Hope Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Alex Hope Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Langley School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Alex Hope Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Alex Hope Elementary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: How much do homes near Alex Hope Elementary sell for?
faq.a: Within 1 km of the school, 239 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,455,650, townhomes $765,000, condos $582,500. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Alex Hope Elementary?
faq.a: For the 239 homes that sold within 1 km of Alex Hope Elementary, the median time on the market was 22 days and the median sale was 97.8% of list; 7% sold above list.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Alex Hope Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Lynn Fripps Elementary (0.6 km south-west), Yorkson Creek Middle School (1.0 km west) and des Voyageurs (1.1 km north-east).

Alex Hope Elementary is an elementary school in Langley (Langley School District), at 21150 85 Ave. It teaches grades K to 7. Programs listed: Late French Immersion.
Use the search below to see homes for sale that name Alex Hope Elementary in the listing, then check the sold prices within 1 km of the school.
How the Alex Hope Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Alex Hope Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 1 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 1 km of Alex Hope Elementary sold for
Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 239 homes sold within 1 km of Alex Hope Elementary: 48 houses, 105 townhomes and 80 condos. The largest group was townhomes, at a median of $765,000.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Alex Hope Elementary

16 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Alex Hope Elementary in a straight line (11 elementary, 2 middle, 2 secondary, 1 other; 1 independent). The closest is Lynn Fripps Elementary, 0.6 km away, and the farthest on this list is R E Mountain Secondary, 2.6 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is Walnut Grove Secondary (1.1 km); the nearest independent school is The King's School (1.9 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Walnut Grove Secondary (1.1 km). Other elementary schools close by: Lynn Fripps Elementary (0.6 km south-west), des Voyageurs (1.1 km north-east), James Kennedy Elementary (1.2 km north), Willoughby Elementary (1.3 km south-west), Richard Bulpitt Elementary (1.5 km south). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is des Voyageurs, 1.1 km north-east of Alex Hope Elementary.
